answer: Each identity must hold one state-issued commercial pilot licence, registry-checked: the licence is a bridge from logged flight hours to exactly one identity; a second claim is rejected. Earning one needs a medical, an exam, 200 logged hours with an over-ocean leg: 1,800 units plus 180 days. 100 fakes cost 180,000 units, 20,000 hours and 18,000 days. Cheapest cheat: hire a licensed pilot to fly under another name. That pilot surrenders the licence backing their own identity and fails the face check, while the oral exam's fourteen-line sonnet of emergency questions exposes the untrained.
